# vastdata_tenant_metric_labels (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vastdata_tenant_metric_labels" "env_label" {
  key           = "environment"
  default_value = "production"
  description   = "Deployment environment tag for tenant metrics."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The unique key for the metric label.

### Optional

- `default_value` (String) The default value for this metric label.
- `description` (String) Description of the metric label purpose.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the metric label was created.
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
